steps.content: Run or schedule.

steps.title: Step 1: Remove the maintenance solution bottle
steps.content: Detach and remove the maintenance solution bottle from the bottled reagent drawer. After disconnecting the two tubes the bottle can be lifted out.

steps.title: Step 2: Clean the bottle
steps.content: Remove the tube connector lid and make sure that tubes and the bottle are clean. If not, wash in warm water until solid residue has dissolved.

steps.title: Step 3: Add maintenance solution
steps.content: Pour the content from three 200 ml Phadia maintenance solution bottles, total 600 ml, into the maintenance solution bottle.

steps.title: Step 4: Restore bottle
steps.content:
Put the tubing lid on the maintenance solution bottle.

Place the bottle back in its position in the bottle drawer.

Attach the two tubing connectors to the bottle. The connectors are keyed and only fit one way. Follow the color markings.

steps.title: Step 5: Start procedure
steps.content:
When the maintenance solution bottle is filled with Phadia maintenance solution, you can start the maintenance procedure by pressing the start button.

The procedure takes about 20 minutes. When finished, the instrument will automatically enter standby mode, and the green light on the signal tower will go out.
